why: Private campsites with no price and no presence anywhere (read 2026-11-22): the only source is one listing on the On Hand Development Corporation's Places to Stay page (millersd.org/places-to-stay/, modified 2025-12-19: 'Gnat Campground West of Farm Tech 1301 W. 1st Ave., Miller ... & also located north of the nursing home 420 E. 6th St.', call an individual's cell 605-870-3613), with no rate, site count, hookups or season; no website, booking engine, Google Maps place, RV Life listing or camper review exists -> fails the private price + presence test (precedent 5842).
name: Gnat Campground
flags: Not a duplicate of 13536 Crystal Park Campground (Miller): Crystal Park is the city's park on W 7th St (44.5253,-98.9952) and is listed separately on the same page; Gnat Campground is listed at two other addresses (1301 W 1st Ave, west of Farm Tech; and north of the nursing home at 420 E 6th St) under a private individual's phone. Neither address is a DB entry; nothing else in the DB lies within 15 km except 5749 Lake Louise RA.
Ownership private: the listing gives only a person's cell number, no city or business operator; the 13536 verifier read it the same way ('a private individual's sites').

Google Maps (headless, 2026-11-22): no place for 'Gnat Campground Miller SD' or 'Gnat RV Miller SD' (the searches fell through to Lake Louise RA and the town). RV Life Algolia within 8 km of Miller: only Crystal Park. Web searches on the name and the phone number find only the millersd.org page.

Dakota at Home (dakotaathome.sd.gov) refused both plain curl (403) and the headless browser (Connect211 automated-client notice), and has no Wayback capture; a Dakota at Home record for Miller turned up in search (30c45742...) but search snippets describe it as a City of Miller parks listing, not Gnat - left unread.

Imagery look at the Google geocode of 1301 W 1st Ave (44.5294,-98.9912, Esri World Imagery, rendered 2026-11-22): a large industrial building on a gravel yard with a couple of trailers parked west of it; no laid-out campground or pads visible. The geocode may be imprecise, and the second (E 6th St) location was not located.
Only a phone call could establish rates and sites; phone calls were out of scope for this lead.
